ModMetaData.name: Shallow Water Floor Tile 1.6
ModMetaData.author: rune1993 - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Shallow water you can lay down like a floor.
Two terrains, both built for 2 wood from the Floors tab: - Shallow water, which behaves like the natural kind. - Fertile water, which crops grow in - fertility 1.25, and no movement penalty.
The original stopped at 1.3.
Fixed along the way: both terrains asked for two build surfaces at once, which is not a thing the game can read - it looked for a surface called "HeavyLight", found none, and neither terrain could be built. They now ask for a light surface, which any soil or floor provides.
